hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` mkdir resources aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv data/Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/data/metadata_new_search.json data/studies_metadata.json --no-progress aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv data/columnMeta.csv --no-progress
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
csvcut -c "Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed" data/Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv IFS=',' [ ! -f inputs.csv ] while read study_id study_type data_ready data_processed do if [[ "${study_id}" == "${datasetRef}" ]]; then mkdir ${study_id} mkdir ${study_id}/output csvformat -z 100000000 -U 2 -p 'φ' -P 'φ' -E -H data/columnMeta.csv > data/columnMeta_formatted.csv jq '[.bio_data_catalyst[] | select(."study_identifier"=="'${study_id}'")]' data/studies_metadata.json > ${study_id}/subset_metadata.json grep "^\"*\\\\${study_id,,}\\\\" data/columnMeta.csv > ${study_id}/subset_columnmeta.csv
java -jar jars/DatasetInputFileGenerator.jar --subsetDir "./${study_id}/" --ref "${study_id}"
java -jar jars/ConceptInputFileGenerator.jar --subsetDir "./${study_id}/" --ref "${study_id}" export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` aws s3 rm s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/${study_id}/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' aws s3 cp ./${study_id}/output/ s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/${study_id}/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' --no-progress unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN curl --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"${study_id}/output/datasets.csv" "${api}/dataset/csv" || exit 255 curl --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"${study_id}/output/consents.csv" "${api}/consent/csv?datasetRef=${study_id}" || exit 255 curl --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"${study_id}/output/concepts.csv" "${api}/concept/csv?datasetRef=${study_id}" || exit 255 fi done < inputs.csv
